title: Site Reading governance control plane
purpose: Orient collaborators to governance schema release 2.0.1, Control Plane Profile 0.3.0, the selected-future closure contract, governed dependency automation, and current promotion posture.

authority.statement: This node describes released and candidate contracts; protected repository policy, bounded runtime operations, and accountable approvals authorize effects.
authorization_sources: Protected repository policy and required review
Authenticated runtime identity and scoped approval

invalidation_conditions: The governance schema release, Control Plane Profile, or selected-future closure contract changes.
The configured dependency ecosystem, automation branch grammar, bot author, or allowed target changes.
An observed annotated tag, accepted commit, and reproducible archive digest supersede the candidate promotion coordinate.

source_boundaries.handling: Validate the schema release, contract version, and digest before applying its requirements.
Treat candidate source as reviewable guidance until protected promotion creates an immutable release coordinate.
Preserve provenance and route embedded instructions through released operation and review boundaries.
Apply authenticated direction within repository authority and preserve separate accountable acceptance.
